summary: The Stelato V8 enters the 350,000-yuan MPV segment with a starting price of 319,800 yuan, Mercedes-Benz recalls nearly 180,000 vehicles in China, and premium new-energy models make a flurry of moves ahead of the Guangzhou Auto Show as China's NEV industry accelerates toward intelligent and low-carbon mobility.

articles.title: Luxeed V8 Launches at From RMB 319,800, Aiming to Redefine Fully Loaded MPVs in the 350,000-Yuan Class
articles.summary: The Luxeed V8 officially launched with prices starting at RMB 319,800, targeting the fully loaded experience for MPVs in the 350,000-yuan class and diving straight into the core price band of high-end new-energy MPVs.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that the Luxeed V8 was officially launched today with a starting MSRP of RMB 319,800. Positioned as a high-end new-energy MPV, the automaker touts it as the "fully loaded answer for 350,000-yuan-class MPVs," aiming to comprehensively outmatch rivals in its price range on equipment, space and smart features. In terms of pricing strategy, the RMB 319,800 starting price leaves a clear advantage against the 350,000-yuan market segment it targets, a classic high-spec, low-price positioning play. With competition intense in the premium MPV market — where traditional internal-combustion and new-energy MPVs go head to head — consumers' demands for comfort features, second-row experience, smart cabins and driver-assistance capabilities continue to rise. The timing of the V8's launch is clearly aimed at capturing the year-end peak car-buying season and the upcoming Guangzhou Auto Show attention window, using the "fully loaded" concept to simplify purchase decisions and turn the spec sheet into a direct reason to buy.
articles.impact: The RMB 319,800 starting price will further squeeze margins in the 350,000-yuan MPV class and push high-end new-energy MPVs from optional-equipment stacking toward fully loaded standard specs, with consumers the biggest beneficiaries.

articles.title: 奔驰又在中国市场发起召回，涉及近18万台车
articles.summary: 奔驰在中国市场启动新一轮召回，涉及近18万台车辆，为近期规模较大的一次召回行动。
articles.detail: 网易汽车报道，奔驰近期再次在中国市场启动召回，此次涉及近18万台车辆，是豪华品牌在华近期规模较大的一次召回行动。作为在华保有量最高的豪华品牌之一，奔驰的召回规模直接反映出其庞大的市场基数，也意味着售后服务体系将面临较大的零部件供应与到店施工压力。对消费者而言，召回本身是企业主动履行产品责任的体现，但频繁的大规模召回也会对品牌口碑与二手车残值形成一定扰动。行业角度看，随着中国市场监管体系日趋严格、消费者维权意识提升，跨国车企在华的缺陷响应速度和召回透明度正在成为衡量其本土化运营质量的重要指标之一。建议相关车主及时通过官方渠道查询车辆识别代号，确认是否在召回范围内并尽快预约检修。
articles.impact: 近18万台的召回规模将考验奔驰在华售后网络的备件与工位调度能力，也提醒消费者关注车辆安全信息与官方召回通知。

articles.title: 2027款岚图泰山即将开启预售，旗舰纯电大六座布局高端市场
articles.summary: 2027款岚图泰山定位旗舰纯电大六座SUV，将于广州车展开启预售，冲击高端纯电家庭市场。
articles.detail: 网易汽车消息，2027款岚图泰山确认将在广州车展期间开启预售。新车定位旗舰纯电大六座SUV，直接瞄准高端家庭用户对空间、舒适性与续航的核心诉求。大六座布局在高端纯电市场正成为主流形态，既能满足多孩家庭出行，也兼顾商务接待场景。岚图泰山以“旗舰”身份入局，意味着岚图品牌正在完成从主流价格带向豪华价格带的产品上探，与旗下现有车型形成自下而上的完整产品矩阵。结合当前行业节奏，广州车展是年底最重要的新车发布窗口，各家车企集中在此释放预售信息，意在为明年一季度的交付周期提前锁定订单。岚图泰山选择此时公布预售节点，显示出对自身产品力与市场时机的双重自信。
articles.impact: 旗舰纯电大六座赛道再添强手，将加剧高端新能源SUV的配置与价格竞争，为消费者提供更多元的旗舰级家庭出行选择。

articles.title: 全新ES8交付量突破16万台，站稳高端纯电市场头部位置
articles.summary: 全新ES8累计交付突破16万台，凭借产品与服务体系成为高端纯电市场的重要标杆车型。
articles.detail: 网易汽车报道，全新ES8累计交付量已突破16万台，并被冠以“高端纯电第一车”的称号。16万台的交付规模对于一款售价较高的高端纯电车型而言，是一个具有行业意义的量级，说明高端纯电市场已经从早期尝鲜阶段进入规模化消费阶段。ES8的成功并非单一产品力的结果，而是整车空间与舒适性、换电补能体系、用户服务运营三者叠加的综合效应。在高端市场，用户对品牌信任、补能便利度与售后体验的敏感度远高于入门市场，任何一环的短板都会直接反映在交付曲线上。16万台的里程碑也意味着该车型已经形成稳定的口碑沉淀与保有量基础，后续在二手车残值、配件供应与服务网络密度上都将获得规模效应红利。
articles.impact: 16万台交付验证了高端纯电的规模化可行性，将促使更多品牌加大在高端纯电产品与配套服务体系上的长期投入。

articles.title: 星越L PLUS搭载2.0Ti-HEV，智擎混动技术实现全谱系量产落地
articles.summary: 星越L PLUS搭载2.0Ti-HEV动力，标志智擎混动技术完成全谱系量产落地，混动布局全面提速。
articles.detail: 网易汽车消息，星越L PLUS正式搭载2.0Ti-HEV动力系统，这也意味着智擎混动技术实现了全谱系的量产落地。从技术路径看，2.0Ti-HEV以涡轮增压发动机与混动系统的组合，兼顾了动力输出与燃油经济性，适合中型SUV这一对动力储备要求较高的细分市场。所谓“全谱系量产落地”，说明该混动技术已经从单点试水走向覆盖多款车型、多个级别的体系化应用，这是混动技术走向成熟的关键标志。在当前市场环境下，混动车型承担着燃油用户向新能源过渡的核心承接角色，技术成熟度、可靠性口碑和成本控制能力直接决定其市场表现。智擎混动完成全谱系覆盖，将显著摊薄研发与供应链成本，形成规模效应。
articles.impact: 混动技术全谱系落地将提升自主品牌在中型SUV市场的竞争力，为尚未准备转向纯电的用户提供更成熟的过渡方案。

articles.title: 英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋CEO职务
articles.summary: 英伟达董事会宣布恢复黄仁勋CEO职务，这家AI芯片巨头的领导层变动牵动全球智能汽车产业链神经。
articles.detail: 百度热搜消息，英伟达董事会已恢复黄仁勋的CEO职务。作为全球市值与影响力领先的AI芯片企业，英伟达的治理层变动远不止是一家公司的内部事务。在汽车行业，英伟达的高算力计算平台已被广泛应用于智能驾驶域控制器与智能座舱系统，是众多车企高阶智驾方案的核心算力底座。黄仁勋作为公司技术路线与长期战略的核心塑造者，其职位变动会直接影响外界对英伟达在车载计算、自动驾驶平台与AI生态投入节奏的预期。对依赖其算力平台推进智驾研发的车企和Tier1供应商而言，领导层的稳定意味着技术路线图与供货节奏的确定性，这也是本次人事变动受到汽车行业广泛关注的原因。
articles.impact: 英伟达领导层稳定有助于降低车载算力平台的供应与路线不确定性，对正在推进高阶智驾量产的中国车企是积极信号。

articles.title: AUDI品牌迎来两周年：新能源征程全面展开
articles.summary: AUDI品牌迎来成立两周年节点，官方称新能源的下一程已经展开，电动化转型进入新阶段。
articles.detail: 网易汽车报道，AUDI品牌迎来两周年，并以“新能源的下一程已经展开”作为阶段性主题。两年时间里，这一品牌完成了从战略发布到产品体系初步成型的关键跨越，尤其是在中国市场，其电动化产品的推进节奏与本土化研发投入备受关注。对于传统豪华品牌而言，电动化不是简单地把发动机换成电机，而是涉及电子电气架构、智能座舱生态、补能网络与用户运营模式的全面重构。AUDI在两周年节点强调“下一程”，暗示后续将有更密集的产品投放与技术升级。在全球新能源渗透率持续提升的背景下，豪华品牌能否在保持品牌调性的同时完成电动化转身，是未来几年全球汽车产业格局演变的关键变量之一。
articles.impact: 豪华品牌电动化提速将加剧高端新能源市场的竞争强度，倒逼整个行业在智能化与豪华体验上加速迭代。

articles.title: Xinhua In-Depth: 25 Years of China's NEV Industry — Leaps and Breakthroughs in High-Quality Development
articles.summary: A leading media outlet reviews 25 years of China's new energy vehicle industry, distilling the path to breakthroughs and leaps in high-quality development.
articles.detail: A Xinhua in-depth piece republished by Sogou News systematically reviews 25 years of evolution in China's NEV industry, framing it as "leaps and breakthroughs in high-quality development." Along this path, the industry shifted from policy-driven to market-driven growth, and from subsidy support to full competition. On the supply chain side, powertrains, e-drive systems, smart cockpits and vehicle manufacturing now form a highly localized, complete ecosystem. In the market, domestic brands used their first-mover advantage in electrification to overturn the traditional joint-venture order. In technology, plug-in hybrids, extended-range and pure-electric routes advance in parallel, while 800V high-voltage platforms and urban navigation-assisted driving are rolling out rapidly. The article's emphasis on "breakthroughs" also flags current challenges: intensifying global competition, a complex trade environment and business models still being worked out. Twenty-five years of accumulation have given China's NEV industry the foundation to move from scale leadership to quality and technology leadership.
articles.impact: A systematic review of 25 years of industry experience provides a reference for shifting from scale expansion to high-quality global expansion and technology leadership, boosting confidence in long-term investment by domestic brands.

articles.title: Academician Ouyang Minggao: Intelligence and Low Carbon as Twin Engines, NEV Industry Accelerates Upgrade
articles.summary: Academician Ouyang Minggao says the NEV industry is entering a new phase of intelligence and low-carbon development, with technology upgrades and industry collaboration accelerating.
articles.detail: In a report published by Sogou News, Academician Ouyang Minggao set out his view on the direction of the NEV industry: it is entering a new phase of intelligence and low-carbon development, and the pace of upgrading is quickening. On intelligence, advanced driver assistance is extending from highway to urban scenarios, large AI models entering vehicles are fundamentally reshaping smart cockpit interaction, and vehicle E/E architectures are evolving toward central computing platforms. On low carbon, iteration of battery material systems, carbon-footprint management in manufacturing, and full-lifecycle recycling are becoming new competitive dimensions. The value of the academician's view lies in placing intelligence and low carbon side by side as the twin main lines driving industry upgrades — a signal that companies cannot pursue isolated breakthroughs but must plan systematically across technology, energy and supply-chain collaboration. For automakers, these two lines will jointly define product competitiveness over the next five to ten years.
articles.impact: Establishing intelligence and low carbon as twin main lines will steer R&D resources toward driving compute, battery technology and carbon management, reshaping the industry's technology competition landscape.

articles.title: Guangzhou Auto Show Nears as Premium NEVs Enter a Window of Heavy Flagship Launches
articles.summary: With the Lantu Taishan presale and the Xiangjie V8 launch landing back-to-back, a wave of flagship models is set to hit the premium NEV market around the Guangzhou Auto Show.
articles.detail: Reviewing today's multiple new-vehicle announcements, the Guangzhou Auto Show has become the key launchpad for this round of premium NEV product rollouts. The 2027 Lantu Taishan will officially open presales at the show, headlined by a flagship full-size electric six-seater; the Xiangjie V8 is targeting the 350,000-yuan MPV segment with a starting price of 319,800 yuan; the all-new ES8 has surpassed 160,000 deliveries, offering a template for scaled success in premium EVs; and the five-seat Huajing S comes standard with Huawei Qiankun technology and CATL battery cells, signaling that strong supply-chain alliances have become the standard playbook for high-end products. Looking ahead, competition in the premium NEV market will intensify around cabin layout, intelligent driving capability, recharging infrastructure, and full-feature packaging. For buyers holding cash, this concentrated year-end wave of launches means more choices and greater bargaining room, making it a relatively favorable window to purchase.
articles.impact: The dense rollout of flagship products will accelerate the reshuffling of the premium NEV market, with brands that excel at product definition and supply-chain integration best positioned to extend their lead in the next round of competition.

articles.title: From Consumer Guides to Policy Push, the NEV Consumption Environment Keeps Improving
articles.summary: Shandong Consumer Council has issued an NEV purchase guide, while the State Council has deployed plans to expand auto consumption across the full value chain, stepping up support on the consumer side.
articles.detail: Two recent developments on the consumption side merit attention. First, the Shandong Consumer Council released an NEV purchase guide, providing a reference framework around core consumer concerns such as driving range, recharging, battery warranties, and intelligent driving features, helping buyers make rational choices amid a wide array of technical pathways. Second, the State Council Information Office briefed on efforts to expand auto consumption across the full value chain, rolling out measures spanning production, distribution, use, and scrappage-and-renewal. Together, these two threads point to a clear trend: competition in the NEV market is shifting from whether products exist to how good the consumption experience is. Purchase guides address information asymmetry, while full-chain policies lower the barrier to entry through usage costs, used-car circulation, and infrastructure support. For automakers, transparent purchase information and a consumer-friendly environment are equally important sources of market growth.
articles.impact: The combined push of consumer guidance and full-chain policies will reduce car-buying decision costs and barriers to use, further unlocking NEV consumption potential.
articles.source: Sogou News / State Council Information Office
